soda_selection: Closest distinct published receivers to the source, restored to published channel order after selection
effect_rule: Mean raw NMSE below zero and coordinate IDW, and at least three of four newly fixed shots better than zero.
scope: Shot-level holdout in two previously accessed surveys. Raw recorded amplitudes, fixed score windows, all outcomes retained. No field-wide inference.
model: Observed local pair time alignment, four frequency bands, component and window-specific shot-held-out ridge fitting
